hero.title: Documenti
hero.description: Turn Paperless documents into connected records, views, entities, rules, imports, and team workflows.

auth.title: Secure team access
auth.body: Work across organizations with protected sessions, invitations, profile settings, MFA-ready flows, and clear account controls.

organizations.title: Connected workspaces
organizations.body: Give every team a shared document workspace with members, roles, saved views, entities, and activity where the work happens.

billing.title: Document workflows
billing.body: Use rules, backfills, imports, and bulk actions to keep documents connected to the people, projects, and records they belong to.

messaging.title: Notifications that matter
messaging.body: Keep users aware of document shares, imports, team changes, and operational events without burying them in noise.

guardrails.title: Operational guardrails
guardrails.body: RLS, audit logs, ownership checks, typed configuration, structured errors, and background workers keep the workspace steady.
